A Rift-touched underdark predator whose hooked arms and beak-like mouth were fearsome even before Rift exposure. Now its carapace is veined with violet light, and its clicking communication has taken on psychic overtones that cause pounding headaches in anyone within range. Hook horrors in the Severed Lands are drawn to veins of Warden-forged metal.
## Traits
**Echolocation.** Can't use blindsight while deafened.
**Keen Hearing.** Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Two hook attacks.
**Hook.** +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing.
